outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the differentiation protocol timeline, not a data plot.
Panel B shows western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C consists of line plots (mean ± SEM over a time-course); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel D shows live fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel E shows flow cytometry scatter/dot plots where each dot already represents an individual cell; scatter plots are exempt.
Panel F is a line plot of positive cell proportions (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G is a line plot (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel H shows immunostaining micrographs of whole-mount EBs, not a data plot.
Panel I shows Tukey box plots of RNA-seq quantifications; box plots already convey distribution and are exempt from requiring individual points overlaid.
Panel J is a heatmap from hierarchical clustering; heatmaps are exempt as individual points are not meaningful in this context.
